messages:
olivia: Quick check — customer tenant acme-tiling (tenant_id: tenant-acme-42) in private VPC reports Grafana showing no Prom metrics since ~02:00 UTC. Where are the canonical ingress endpoints for Prom remote_write vs OTLP? Any quick checks before I page infra?

kevin: First, confirm their promtail/prom remote_write URL and token. For private VPC the ingestion URL usually looks like: https://otlp-ingest.prod.internal.redwood.com/v1/prom/<tenant-id> — Grafana should point at the read/TSDB endpoint, not the ingest URL.

olivia: They sent this promtail snippet: ```clients:
  - url: "https://otlp-ingest.prod.internal.redwood.com/v1/prom/tenant-acme-42"
    bearer_token: "redacted"```
They say token was rotated last week.

maria: Quick checks:
- relayer logs for 401/403/429/5xx: ```kubectl -n obs logs deploy/otlp-relayer -l app=otlp-relayer -c relayer | grep tenant-acme-42 -B2 -A2```
- relayer queue/backpressure metric: `relay_queue_length` and `remote_write_rejected_total`
- confirm grafana datasource URL: should be `https://tsdb-read.prod.internal.redwood.com/api/datasources/proxy/1/` (org/datasource proxy route).

olivia: Ran logs — seeing repeated 429s starting ~02:03 and a handful of 401s earlier around 01:58. 429 payload: `ingress: rate limited, labels cardinality high`

sam: 429s usually mean tenant-level rate limiting or our dedupe/ingest backpressure triggered. For private VPCs high label cardinality from service discovery can blow past the per-tenant label cap. Check metrics: `otlp_ingest_ingress_rejected_by_rate` and `otlp_ingest_remote_write_rejected_total`. Also inspect promtail config for relabeling to drop high-card labels.

kevin: Also ensure Grafana datasource isn't pointed at the ingest endpoint by mistake (common in onboarding). Grafana dashboard for quick triage: https://grafana.internal.redwood.com/d/obs/customer-overview?orgId=1&var-tenant=tenant-acme-42

maria: If 401s appear after a rotation, verify their token in our secrets store: secrets/tenant-acme-42/token and the rotation service logs: `kubectl -n infra logs deploy/kms-rotations`. If we see mismatch, re-issue token or add a short forwarding rule.

sre-bot: Alert fired: OTLPIngestRateLimitExceeded tenant-acme-42 at 2026-03-16T02:04Z — https://alerts.redwood.com/alerts/OTLPIngestRateLimitExceeded/tenant-acme-42

olivia: Action plan: I'll ask the customer to temporarily increase `scrape_interval` and apply relabeling to drop pod_label_x where cardinality explodes, then ramp back slowly. I'll attach relayer logs and the grafana link.

kevin: If they need immediate relief we can temporarily raise tenant quota for 30m from infra console — ping me and I'll approve. Also file a quick postmortem if >10% error rate over 1h.

maria: Extra tip: for future onboardings add a small relabel config to promtail to drop `pod_ip`/`pod_name` labels for noisy services. Example: ```relabel_configs:
  - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_name]
    action: drop
    regex: noisy-worker-.*```

olivia: Thanks all — will update thread after customer applies throttles and we check relayer metrics.
